proof_decision.trust_question: Does strict source-checkout validation reject every committed source-current state whose declared workspace payload, module-managed skills, or release provenance is stale?
proof_decision.narrowest_evidence: Two focused checker tests prove that a matching source-current fixture passes and that stale provenance plus stale workspace and module skill payloads fail; the strict checker run proves the real repository is currently aligned.
proof_decision.prune_or_replacement_condition: Replace only when a narrower authoritative committed-state validator proves the same source-current version, declared workspace payload, and module-managed skill alignment and remains in the strict maintainer validation lane.
proof_decision.residual_risk: The guard intentionally excludes root-owned Planning and Memory state and module payload categories not declared as workspace payload files or managed skills; newly managed categories must be added to the alignment contract.
